issue.title: Document that just check skips toobig
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `lint_and_test.md`

`just check` and `just check-full` run every whole-repo lint gate except `toobig`; CI enforces `toobig` through `just lint`, while the `toobig_split` routine owns file splits. This was identified while implementing approved plan:202609/drop_toobig_from_check.md.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: State that just check and just check-full skip the toobig line-count gate; CI enforces it via just lint, and the toobig_split routine owns splits.
